effect.en:
This unit’s **Blissbrew Homonculi** are tokens. There is 1 **Blissbrew Homonculus** for every 10 models in this unit.

This unit has **WARD (6+)** while it has any **Blissbrew Homonculi**. If you make an unmodified ward roll of 1 for this unit, remove 1 of this unit’s **Blissbrew Homonculi** from the battlefield (the damage point is still inflicted).

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase

declare.en: Pick a visible enemy unit in combat to be the target.

effect.en: For the rest of the turn, this unit’s ranged weapons have **Shoot in Combat** and they also have **Crit (Auto-wound)** for attacks that target that enemy unit.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase

effect.en: This unit can use **SHOOT** abilities this turn even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn. In addition, for the rest of the turn, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **RETREAT** abilities.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase

declare.en: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn

declare.en: Pick a visible **MANIFESTATION** within 12" of this unit and that was not summoned this turn to be the target, then make a banishment roll of 2D6.

effect.en:
If the banishment roll equals or exceeds the banishment value on the target’s warscroll, it is banished and removed from play. 

The next time a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses a **SUMMON** ability, roll an additional D6, to a maximum of 3, when making the casting roll for that ability.

units.notes_en: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Slaaneshi Beguiler*.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

effect.en: If this unit charged this turn, it can move D3+3". It can pass through enemy models and the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move within ½" of a visible enemy unit.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

declare.en: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this terrain feature to be the target.

effect.en:
Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, while the target is within **X"** of this terrain feature, the target’s weapons have the **Companion** weapon ability, where **X** is determined by the current battle round as follows:

**Battle Round - X**
1 - 9"
2 - 12"
3 - 15"
4 - 18"
5 - 21"

This rule varies depending on the battlepack selected for your army:

**General's Handbook 2024-25**
Models cannot move across, be set up on or end moves on any part of this terrain feature.

**General's Handbook 2025-26**
Models cannot move across, be set up on or end moves on any part of this terrain feature.

**General's Handbook 2026-27**
Models cannot move across, be set up on or end moves on any part of this terrain feature.

This rule varies depending on the battlepack selected for your army:

**General's Handbook 2024-25**
Subtract 1 from **hit rolls** for attacks that target a unit that is behind or wholly on this terrain feature, unless that unit **charged** this turn or has the **FLY** keyword.

**General's Handbook 2025-26**
Subtract 1 from **hit rolls** for attacks that target a unit that is behind or wholly on this terrain feature, unless that unit **charged** this turn or has the **FLY** keyword.

**General's Handbook 2026-27**
Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target a unit that is behind or wholly on this terrain feature, unless that unit charged this turn or has the **FLY** keyword.

wargear.en:
**The following universal terrain abilities apply to this terrain feature (Terrain, 1.2):**

**Cover, Impassable**

effect.en: If this unit charged this turn, subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy **INFANTRY** units while they are in combat with this unit.

units.notes_en: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **FIGHT** ability for this unit

effect.en: Pick a friendly non-**HERO SYBARITE** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by this unit and the target for the rest of the turn.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

declare.en: If this unit has not used a **TEMPTATION** ability this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

effect.en:
Your opponent must decide whether the target will **accept** or **decline** this unit’s challenge:

If they **accept**, for the rest of the turn, if this unit is in combat with the target when the target is picked to use a **FIGHT** ability, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks and all of the target’s attacks must target this unit.

If they **decline**, for the rest of the turn:
• The target has **STRIKE-LAST**.
• Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for attacks that target that enemy unit.

effect.en: While they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit, melee weapons used by friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH INFANTRY** units have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)**.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

declare.en: If this unit has not used a **TEMPTATION** ability this turn, pick a visible friendly **SYBARITE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

effect.en:
If the target is a **PARAGON**, apply the following effect to the target. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the following effect to the target:

• For the rest of the turn, while the target is wholly within 12" of this unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.

units.notes_en: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Dark Egotist.*

declare.en: Pick a visible friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

effect.en: You can allocate 1 damage point to the target (ward rolls cannot be made for that damage point). Then, roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target can use **CHARGE** abilities even if they used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.

This unit has **WARD (5+)** while it is in combat. In addition, each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit for a damage point inflicted by a combat attack, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

units.notes_en: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Dark Egotist*.

effect.en: For the rest of the turn, for each unmodified hit roll of 1 for a combat attack made by that enemy unit that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase

declare.en: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.

effect.en: The target cannot use reactions or be picked to be the target of reactions used by your opponent or by units in your opponent’s army for the rest of the turn.

effect.en: Set up this unit in reserve **waiting in ambush**. It has now been deployed.

effect.en: This unit can move up to 3" immediately after that command has been resolved, unless that command is a reaction, in which case this unit can move after the ability that it was reacting to has been resolved. That move can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units, and can end in combat.

effect.en: Set up this unit on the battlefield wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

name.ja: Scourge of Ghyran Syll'Esske, the Vengeful Allegiance

effect.en: When players are alternating picking units to use a **FIGHT** ability, when it is your turn to pick a unit, instead of picking 1 unit, you can pick a friendly non-**HERO HEDONITES OF SLAANESH DAEMON** unit wholly within 18" of this unit and a friendly non-**HERO SYBARITE** unit wholly within 18" of this unit. Resolve the second **FIGHT** ability immediately after the first.

If any damage points were allocated to an enemy **WIZARD** or **PRIEST** by this unit’s combat attacks this turn and that enemy unit has been destroyed, add 1 to this unit’s power level for the rest of the battle. This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.

declare.en: Pick up to 1 visible friendly non-**HERO SYBARITE INFANTRY** unit and up to 1 visible friendly non-**HERO HEDONITES OF SLAANESH DAEMON INFANTRY** unit to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

effect.en: If you picked a **SYBARITE** target, subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by its combat attacks until the start of your next turn. If you picked a **DAEMON** target, it has **WARD (5+)** until the start of your next turn.

declare.en: If this unit has not used a **TEMPTATION** ability this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

effect.en:
Your opponent must decide whether the target will **adulate** or **reject** Sigvald.

***Adulate:*** Until the start of your next turn, while the target is in combat with this unit, it must pick this unit to be the target of pile-in moves it makes.

***Reject:*** Inflict D3+3 mortal damage on the target, then **Heal (X)** this unit, where **X** is the number of damage points inflicted on the target this turn by this ability.

If this unit charged this turn and the unmodified charge roll was 6+ , for the rest of the turn:

• This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST**.
• The Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Shardslash** is equal to the unmodified charge roll.
• Melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, used by other friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** units have **Crit (2 Hits)** while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.

It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat. If this unit was in combat at the start of the move, it must end that move in combat with the units it was already in combat with at the start of the move.

effect.en: You can re-roll the charge roll.
While this unit is damaged or has fewer than half its starting models, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of its melee weapons.

effect.en:

• The target is **blissmarked** for the rest of the turn.
This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** while it is in combat with a **blissmarked** unit.
